player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id} i te kēmu o te Tic Tac Toe Whakamuri. Ko '{symbol}' tō tohu.
Ko te whāinga, kia kaua e whakapā tētahi rārangi toru (ā-horahora, ā-poutū, ā-tītaha).
Ki te hanga tētahi rārangi toru, ka HINGA koe.
Tukua tō neke ki te whakatakoto '[4]' hei whakapū tō tohu ki te wāhanga 4.
Hei Kaiwhakataetae {player_id}, ko '{symbol}' koe, ā, ko '{opponent_symbol}' tō hoa whawhai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: He hōputu nekehanga kāore i te tika. Whakamahia '[cell]'.

game_action.placed: Kaitakaro {player_id} i whakapumau i to tohu ({symbol}) ki roto i te poraka {cell}.

outcome.loss: Ka ngaro te kaitākaro {player_id} mā te whakaoti i tētahi rārangi!
outcome.draw: He toenga! Kaore he tangata i ngaro.
